name: factfinch-monorepo
description: Plain-language interview engine inspired by the IRS Fact Graph: rules as data, ask only what's still needed, explain every result.
author: lobojoel2003

scripts.dev: npm run stamp && npm run dev -w @factfinch/demo
scripts.build: npm run stamp && npm run build -w factfinch && npm run build -w @factfinch/demo
scripts.build:lib: npm run stamp && npm run build -w factfinch
scripts.test: npm run stamp && npm run test -w factfinch && npm run test -w @factfinch/demo
scripts.test:coverage: npm run stamp && npm run test:coverage -w factfinch && npm run test -w @factfinch/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run stamp && npm run typecheck -w factfinch && npm run typecheck -w @factfinch/demo
scripts.validate:rules: npm run build:lib && node packages/factfinch/dist/cli.js validate packages/factfinch/rules/us-eitc-ctc-2025.json && node packages/factfinch/dist/cli.js test packages/factfinch/rules/us-eitc-ctc-2025.json packages/factfinch/rules/us-eitc-ctc-2025.cases.json
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run validate:rules
